        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",

1000 {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distance, meterUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%d %@\", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)\n            }\n        } else {\n            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_feet_unit\", comment: \"Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_miles_unit\", comment: \"Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048\n            let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34\n            if distanceInFeet &gt; 528 { // More than 1/10 mile\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.2f %@\", distanceInMiles, milesUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distanceInFeet, feetUnit)\n            }\n        }\n        let separator = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_separator\", comment: \"Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle\")\n        let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n        let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_distance\", comment: \"Label for the distance to the device in the device list row\")\n        return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(relativeTimeWithOffset) \\(separator) \\(distanceLabel): \\(formattedDistance)\"\n    }\n\n    private func placemarkText(from cached: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt;         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MapHelpers.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\n\n// Helper function for MapStyle\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\nfunc mapStyleFromSettings(_ mapType: Int) -&gt; MapStyle {\n    switch mapType {\n    case 2:\n        return .hybrid(elevation: .automatic)\n    case 3:\n        return .imagery(elevation: .automatic)\n    default:\n        return .standard(elevation: .automatic)\n    }\n}\n\n// Helper function for zoom level (in km)\nfunc spanForZoomLevel(_ zoomLevel: Int) -&gt; MKCoordinateSpan {\n    // 1° latitude ≈ 111 km\n    let km = Double(zoomLevel)\n    let delta = km / 111.0\n    return MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: delta, longitudeDelta: delta)\n}\n\n// Helper function to calculate current zoom level from span\nfunc currentZoomLevelFromSpan(_ span: MKCoordinateSpan) -&gt; Int {\n    // Average of latitude and longitude delta\n    let avgDelta = (span.latitudeDelta + span.longitudeDelta) / 2.0\n    // Convert back to km: 1° ≈ 111 km\n    let km = avgDelta * 111.0\n    return Int(round(km))\n}\n\n/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. \"2 minutes ago\" or \"now\")\nfunc relativeTimeString(\n    from date: Date?,\n    to now: Date = Date(),\n    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,\n    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10\n) -&gt; String {\n    guard let date = date else { return \"–\" }",

        "contents": "        \n        let currentLocale = Locale.current\n        let dateFormatter = DateFormatter()\n        dateFormatter.dateFormat = \"d MMMM yyyy\"\n        dateFormatter.locale = currentLocale\n        var dateString = dateFormatter.string(from: visitor.TimeStampDate)\n        \n        // Add ordinal suffix only for English locales (st, nd, rd, th)\n        if currentLocale.language.languageCode?.identifier == \"en\" {\n            // Extract the day number from the formatted date string\n            let calendar = Calendar.current\n            let day = calendar.component(.day, from: visitor.TimeStampDate)\n            let ordinalSuffix = ordinalSuffix(for: day)\n            \n            // Find the first occurrence of the day number and add ordinal suffix\n            // Match day number followed by a space (to avoid matching year)\n            if let range = dateString.range(of: \"\\\\b\\(day) \", options: .regularExpression) {\n                dateString.replaceSubrange(range, with: \"\\(day)\\(ordinalSuffix) \")\n            }\n        }\n        \n        let separator = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_separator\", comment: \"Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle\")\n        let exactDateTime = \"\\(timeString) \\(separator) \\(dateString)\"",

        "contents": "    private func formattedDistance(_ meters: CLLocationDistance) -&gt; String {\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n        let value: Double\n        let unit: UnitLength\n        if usesMetric {\n            value = meters / 1000.0\n            unit = .kilometers\n        } else {\n            value = meters / 1609.344\n            unit = .miles\n        }\n        let measurement = Measurement(value: value, unit: unit)\n        let formatter = MeasurementFormatter()\n        formatter.locale = .current\n        formatter.unitStyle = .short\n        formatter.unitOptions = .providedUnit\n        let numberFormatter = NumberFormatter()\n        numberFormatter.maximumFractionDigits = 0\n        numberFormatter.minimumFractionDigits = 0\n        formatter.numberFormatter = numberFormatter\n        return formatter.string(from: measurement)\n    }\n\n    private func transportSymbolName() -&gt; String {\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\n        case 0: return \"figure.walk\"\n        case 2: return \"car\"\n        case 3: return \"tram\"\n        default: return \"car\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func updateBottomAccessory() {\n        if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {\n            let visible = (travelTime != nil || distanceText != nil)\n            routeInfoState.update(\n                etaText: travelTime,\n                distanceText: distanceText,\n                transportSymbolName: transportSymbolName(),\n                visible: visible,\n                isMutualNavigation: mutualNavigationDetector.isMutualNavigation\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    \n}",

These strings are no longer used because the code was refactored to use iOS’s `RelativeDateTimeFormatter` instead of manual formatting.

## Current Implementation

The codebase now uses `RelativeDateTimeFormatter` in `MapHelpers.swift`:

```44:61:miataru/views/Common/Map/MapHelpers.swift
/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. "2 minutes ago" or "now")
func relativeTimeString(
    from date: Date?,
    to now: Date = Date(),
    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,
    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10
) -> String {
    guard let date = date else { return "–" }
    let diff = now.timeIntervalSince(date)
    if date > now {
        return NSLocalizedString("relative_time_now", comment: "Indicates that the location update just happened or is happening right now in a relative time on the map marker.")
    } else if diff < timeConsideredNow {
        return NSLocalizedString("relative_time_now", comment: "Indicates that the location update just happened or is happening right now in a relative time on the map marker.")
    }
    let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()
    formatter.unitsStyle = unitsStyle
    return formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: now)
}
```

## Why the Change?

1. Automatic localization: `RelativeDateTimeFormatter` handles all locales without manual strings.
2. Less maintenance: no need to maintain separate strings for each time unit.
3. Better consistency: follows iOS conventions.
4. Edge cases: handles pluralization, formatting, and edge cases automatically.

## Status

- The strings (`time_ago_days`, `time_ago_hours`, `time_ago_minutes`) are marked as `"extractionState": "stale"` in `Localizable.xcstrings`.
- They are not referenced in any Swift code (no `NSLocalizedString` calls found).
- They only appear in `.specstory` history files.

You can safely remove these strings from `Localizable.xcstrings` since they’re no longer needed.

Built with SwiftUI and modern iOS frameworks (iOS 18 and iOS 26).\n\n## Code Style &amp; Standards\n- Use SwiftUI best practices\n- Follow iOS Human Interface Guidelines\n- Maintain privacy-first approach\n- Use English for all code comments and strings\n- Implement proper error handling and battery optimization\n\n## Architecture Guidelines\n- Use ObservableObject and @Published for state management\n- Keep views lightweight and delegate business logic to managers\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Use UserDefaults for settings persistence\n- Handle location permissions gracefully\n\n## Key Components\n- LocationManager: Handles location tracking and permissions\n- SettingsManager: Manages user preferences\n- Device management and QR code functionality\n- Multi-platform support (iPhone, iPad, Mac)\n\n## Development Workflow\n- Test on multiple device types\n- Consider battery optimization\n- Maintain privacy compliance\n- Follow iOS app store guidelines\n\n## Common Patterns\n- Use @StateObject for view models\n- Implement proper onboarding flow\n- Handle background/foreground transitions\n- Manage device identifiers securely\n\n## Localization Guidelines\n\n### String Localization\n**ALWAYS** use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; for all user-facing text strings with proper English descriptions.\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(NSLocalizedString(\"no_groups_available_create_new\", comment: \"No groups available.           },
          {
            "text": "## Common Patterns",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### String Localization",

          },
          {
            "text": "**ALWAYS** use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; for all user-facing text strings with proper English descriptions.",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### Localization Key Naming Convention",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Follow the pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;",

          },

        "contents": "# miataru - App Store Description\n\n## Subtitle (30 characters max)\nYour Location, Your Control\n\n---\n\n## Description (4000 characters max) + Prompt\ntake this \"description text\" and translate these in this order: English, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Spanish, Simplified-Chinese \nOutput in this language order and make each language individually copyable markdown.Each copyable markdown portion has a small note of the language before the markdown and no markdown headline itself. It should be real markdown.\n\nDescription Text:\n\nTake control of your location sharing with miataru - the privacy-focused location sharing app that puts you in charge.\n\nmiataru is a powerful location tracking and sharing app designed for people who value privacy and control. Share your location with family, friends, or trusted devices through your own Miataru server, keeping your data secure and under your control.\n\nPrivacy First:\nYour location data belongs to you. miataru connects to Miataru servers that you choose, ensuring your location information never goes through third-party services you don't trust. You control who sees your location and when.\n\nSmart Location Tracking:\n• Background and foreground location sharing\n• Battery-optimized tracking that respects your device's power\n• High-accuracy updates when you need them, efficient monitoring when you don't\n\nMulti-Device Management:\n• Track multiple devices from a single app\n• Organize devices into custom groups for easy management\n• See battery levels, altitude, speed, and distance for each device\n\nBeautiful Maps &amp; Navigation:\n• Interactive maps with accuracy indicators\n• Real-time device positions with visual feedback\n• Off-screen arrows point to devices outside your current view\n• Built-in navigation with route planning and progress tracking\n\nEasy Sharing:\n• Generate QR codes to share your device instantly\n• Scan QR codes to add new devices quickly\n• Share via email, messages, or any app\n\nDesigned for iOS:",

        "contents": "                        }\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"periodic_location_update_interval_explanation\", comment: \"Explanation for periodic location update interval picker\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    }\n                }\n                Section(header: Text(\"server_url\")) {\n                    TextField(\"server_url\", text: $settings.miataruServerURL)\n                }\n                Section(header: Text(\"app_behaviour\")) {\n                    Toggle(\"deactivate_device_lock\", isOn: $settings.disableDeviceAutolock)\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"explanation_deactivate_device_lock\", comment: \"Explanation for deactivate device lock toggle\"))\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    Toggle(\"pulsating_map_markers\", isOn: $settings.pulsingMapMarkers)\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"explanation_pulsating_map_markers\", comment: \"Explanation for pulsating map markers toggle\"))\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    Toggle(\"indicate_location_accuracy\", isOn: $settings.indicateAccuracyOnMap)\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"explanation_indicate_location_accuracy\", comment: \"Explanation for indicate location accuracy toggle\"))\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    // Removed separate toggle for showing other devices on the map. Using offscreen arrows toggle instead.\n                    Toggle(\"show_offscreen_arrows_for_other_devices\", isOn: $settings.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices)\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"explanation_show_offscreen_arrows_for_other_devices\", comment: \"Explanation for show offscreen arrows for other devices toggle\"))\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./APP_FEATURES.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 83
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 112
          }
        },
        "contents": "- Add other devices by scanning their Miataru QR code.\n- The QR tab offers one‑tap sharing, and the add‑device sheet guides scanning and rejects non‑Miataru codes.\n\n- The share sheet includes additional options, and email sharing attaches the QR image reliably.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96; renders customizable QR codes using the &#96;QRCode&#96; package and supports &#96;ShareLink&#96; and &#96;MFMailComposeViewController&#96;.\n- &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; validates the &#96;miataru://&#96; prefix from scanned codes before accepting an ID and allows manual entry with color selection.\n\n## Onboarding Flow\n**For users:**\n- A six‑step wizard guides through welcome, permissions, server URL, history settings, personal QR code display, and completion.\n- Each step shows illustrations and contextual explanations; server selection validates custom HTTPS URLs, and completion flag controls whether the wizard reappears on next launch.\n\n**For developers:**\n- Platform‑specific containers (&#96;iPhone_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;iPad_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;Mac_OnboardingContainerView&#96;) embed the individual onboarding pages and update &#96;SettingsManager&#96; and &#96;UserDefaults.hasCompletedOnboarding&#96; as the user progresses.\n\n## Settings and Configuration\n**For users:**\n- Control tracking, data retention, server URL, device autolock, accuracy indicators, map type, zoom level, update interval, group zoom‑to‑fit, off‑screen arrows, auto‑refresh, reverse geocoding threshold, navigation mode, and route progress.\n- View location tracking details or replay the onboarding wizard.\n- Settings are grouped into tracking, app behavior, map configuration, and navigation sections for easier discovery.\n\n- All app preferences are also available in the system Settings app.\n- New options include: navigation route auto‑update, route progress visualization toggle, a global pulsing/shimmer switch for map markers, and off‑screen arrow visibility.\n- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;SettingsManager&#96; stores all preferences in &#96;UserDefaults&#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Add other devices by scanning their Miataru QR code.",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- The QR tab offers one‑tap sharing, and the add‑device sheet guides scanning and rejects non‑Miataru codes.",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "- The share sheet includes additional options, and email sharing attaches the QR image reliably.",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "**For developers:**",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96; renders customizable QR codes using the &#96;QRCode&#96; package and supports &#96;ShareLink&#96; and &#96;MFMailComposeViewController&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; validates the &#96;miataru://&#96; prefix from scanned codes before accepting an ID and allows manual entry with color selection.",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "## Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**For users:**",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- A six‑step wizard guides through welcome, permissions, server URL, history settings, personal QR code display, and completion.",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- Each step shows illustrations and contextual explanations; server selection validates custom HTTPS URLs, and completion flag controls whether the wizard reappears on next launch.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "**For developers:**",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "- Platform‑specific containers (&#96;iPhone_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;iPad_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;Mac_OnboardingContainerView&#96;) embed the individual onboarding pages and update &#96;SettingsManager&#96; and &#96;UserDefaults.hasCompletedOnboarding&#96; as the user progresses.",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "## Settings and Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "**For users:**",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- Control tracking, data retention, server URL, device autolock, accuracy indicators, map type, zoom level, update interval, group zoom‑to‑fit, off‑screen arrows, auto‑refresh, reverse geocoding threshold, navigation mode, and route progress.",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- View location tracking details or replay the onboarding wizard.",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- Settings are grouped into tracking, app behavior, map configuration, and navigation sections for easier discovery.",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "- All app preferences are also available in the system Settings app.",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- New options include: navigation route auto‑update, route progress visualization toggle, a global pulsing/shimmer switch for map markers, and off‑screen arrow visibility.",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "**For developers:**",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;SettingsManager&#96; stores all preferences in &#96;UserDefaults&#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.",
            "lineNumber": 112
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "# miataru iOS App - Project Overview\n\n## 🎯 Project Purpose\nmiataru is a privacy-focused iOS application that enables users to track their device location, share it securely with trusted parties, and manage multiple devices and groups. The app prioritizes user privacy, battery efficiency, and cross-platform compatibility.\n\n## 🏗️ Architecture Overview\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: SwiftUI (iOS 18.0+)\n- **State Management**: ObservableObject pattern with @Published properties\n- **Data Persistence**: UserDefaults via SettingsManager; Application Support files for devices/groups\n- **Location Services**: CoreLocation framework (foreground and significant-change background)\n- **QR Code**: CodeScanner (scan), QRCode (generate)\n- **Platforms**: iPhone and iPad\n\n### Core Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataruApp.swift (Entry Point)\n├── MiataruRootView (Main Navigation)\n├── OnboardingContainerView (User Setup)\n├── LocationManagers/\n│   └── LocationManager.swift\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── App Settings/ (SettingsManager, thisDeviceIDManager, Settings.bundle)\n│   └── Devices/ (KnownDevice, KnownDeviceStore)\n│   └── Groups/ (DeviceGroup, DeviceGroupStore)\n├── views/\n│   ├── Common/ (Shared UI)\n│   ├── iPhone/ (iPhone-specific)\n│   ├── iPad/ (iPad-specific)\n│   └── Mac/ (onboarding previews only)\n└── Assets/ (Resources &amp; Localization)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Common Components Overview\n\n- Shared UI (&#96;views/Common/&#96;):\n  - &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96;, &#96;ViewModifiers&#96; (adaptive toolbars/navigation)\n  - Device &amp; group UI: &#96;DeviceRowView&#96;, &#96;GroupRowView&#96;, &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96;, &#96;DeviceBatterySymbol&#96;\n  - Map UI &amp; helpers (&#96;views/Common/Map/&#96;): &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96;, &#96;PulsingAccuracyCircle&#96;, &#96;MapScaleBar&#96; (+ &#96;MapScaleBarViewModel&#96;), &#96;MapCompass&#96;, &#96;OffScreenDeviceArrow&#96;, &#96;OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper&#96;, &#96;RouteGhostCalculator&#96;, &#96;RouteStyle&#96;, &#96;Shimmer&#96;\n- Data &amp; Caching:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving under Application Support)",

        "contents": "- Data &amp; Caching:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving under Application Support)\n  - &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&#96; (latest device locations + reverse geocoded placemarks)\n  - &#96;RouteCacheStore&#96; (cached routes keyed by device/transport; distance threshold validation)\n- Utilities:\n  - &#96;thisDeviceIDManager&#96; (device ID generation + legacy migration)\n  - &#96;Haptic&#96; (feedback utilities)\n\n## 🔑 Key Features\n\n### Location Management\n- **Privacy-First**: User controls all location sharing\n- **Battery Optimized**: High-accuracy foreground; significant-change background\n- **Permission Handling**: Staged requests (WhenInUse → Always when opted-in)\n- **Background Support**: Significant-change updates\n\n### Device Management\n- **Multi-Device**: Track multiple devices\n- **Group Support**: Organize devices into groups\n- **QR Code Sharing**: Share own device, scan to add others\n- **Deep Link**: &#96;miataru://&lt;DEVICE_ID&gt;&#96; adds devices via sheet\n\n### User Experience\n- **Onboarding Flow**: Guided setup (iPhone/iPad-optimized)\n- **Settings Control**: Comprehensive preferences via SettingsManager\n- **Error Handling**: Transient overlays\n- **Localization**: German, English, and Japanese\n\n## 📱 Platform-Specific Considerations\n\n### iPhone\n- Touch-optimized interface\n- Location permission workflows\n- Deep-link and QR onboarding\n- Battery optimization features\n\n### iPad\n- Larger screen layouts\n- Split view support\n- Enhanced device management\n- Optimized for productivity\n\n### Mac\n- Not currently targeted (Mac directory hosts onboarding previews only)\n\n## 🛠️ Development Guidelines\n\n### Code Organization\n- **Views**: Minimal UI logic, delegate to managers\n- **Managers**: Handle business logic and data\n- **Models**: Use SwiftUI data binding\n- **Assets**: Organized by platform and feature\n\n### State Management\n- Use ObservableObject for view models\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Handle app lifecycle changes\n- Manage user preferences reactively\n\n### Testing Strategy\n- Unit tests for business logic\n- UI tests for critical flows",

        "contents": "• Share via email, messages, or any app\n\nDesigned for iOS:\n• Native SwiftUI interface optimized for iPhone and iPad\n• iPad multitasking support - open devices in separate windows\n\nBattery Conscious:\n• Intelligent background tracking that minimizes battery drain\n• Automatic animation reduction in Low Power Mode\n• Smart update intervals that balance accuracy and efficiency\n\nSelf-Hosted Server Support:\nConnect to your own Miataru server or choose from trusted community servers. Your location data stays where you want it - no cloud services, no data mining, no unwanted tracking.\n\nPerfect For:\n• Families wanting to stay connected safely\n• Friends sharing locations during trips\n• People managing multiple devices\n• Anyone who values privacy in location sharing\n• Users who prefer self-hosted solutions\n\nPrivacy &amp; Security:\nmiataru is designed with privacy at its core. Your location data is only shared with the Miataru server you configure, and only with devices you explicitly add.         "contents": "    private func subtitleText(from cached: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let cached = cached else {\n            let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n            let never = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_never\", comment: \"Default value for never seen device\")\n            let separator = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_separator\", comment: \"Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle\")\n            let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_distance\", comment: \"Label for the distance to the device in the device list row\")\n            let unknown = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_unknown\", comment: \"Default value for unknown distance\")\n            return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(never) \\(separator) \\(distanceLabel): \\(unknown)\"\n        }\n        // Relative time\n        let now = Date()\n        let relativeTime = relativeTimeString(from: cached.timestamp, to: now, unitsStyle: .abbreviated)\n        // Add timezone offset if available\n        let timezoneOffset = timezoneOffsetString(deviceTimeZone: cache.getTimeZone(for: device.DeviceID))\n        let relativeTimeWithOffset = timezoneOffset != nil ? \"\\(relativeTime) (\\(timezoneOffset!))\" : relativeTime\n        // Distance calculation\n        guard let myCached = cache.getLocation(for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID) else {\n            let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n            return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(relativeTimeWithOffset)\"\n        }\n        let deviceLoc = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        let myLoc = CLLocation(latitude: myCached.latitude, longitude: myCached.longitude)\n        let distance = deviceLoc.distance(from: myLoc) // in meters\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric",

        "contents": "# miataru App – Feature and Developer Guide\n\nThis document lists all features offered by the miataru iOS app. Each item is described twice: once for **users** and once for **developers**. The descriptions also outline how the feature behaves in the interface so the flow from view to view is clear.\n\n## App Navigation and Views\n**For users:**\n- The app launches to a tab bar with **Devices**, **Groups**, **QR**, and **Settings** tabs. Each tab retains its own navigation stack, so returning to a tab restores where you left off.\n- Tapping a device or group drills into dedicated map screens, while the QR tab always displays your personal code for quick sharing.\n\n- On iPad, you can open a device in a new window from the list or map via context menu, or by dragging the item toward the screen edge.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;iPhone_RootView&#96; constructs the &#96;TabView&#96; and hosts &#96;iPhone_DevicesView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_GroupsView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96;, and &#96;iPhone_SettingsView&#96;.\n- &#96;MiataruRootView&#96; selects platform‑specific root containers so iPad and Mac can embed their own navigation styles.\n- iPad supports opening device detail windows using a value‑based &#96;WindowGroup(for: String)&#96; and context menu/drag interactions.\n\n## Location Tracking\n**For users:**\n- Enable background and foreground tracking in *Settings* to share your location with a Miataru server.\n- The app sends updates even with the screen locked and records a log of recent updates.\n- Location sharing can store history on the server and works offline until network connectivity resumes.\n- Tracking accuracy, activity type, and sensitivity are configurable in *Settings*, and a \"Location Tracking Details\" page shows the last GPS and server updates.\n\n- When supported by your device/client, the app also submits altitude (above sea level), speed, and battery level with location updates.\n- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; publishes the current location, permission state, server update status, altitude, speed, battery level (when available), and a log of recent updates. It switches between high‑accuracy updates in the foreground and significant‑change monitoring in the background, requests authorization when needed, and uploads data using &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;.",
        "signatures": {},

            "text": "## Location Tracking",

        "contents": "struct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry\n\n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                content(for: device)\n                    .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                placeholder\n            }\n        }\n        .containerBackground(for: .widget) {\n            ContainerRelativeShape()\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground))\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let distanceText = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        let (nameFont, detailFont, distanceFont, updateFont, spacing, padding) = metrics(for: family)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {\n            Text(device.name)\n                .font(nameFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)\n            Text(locality)\n                .font(detailFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)\n            if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(distanceFont)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)\n                Text(lastUpdate)\n                    .font(updateFont)\n                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)\n            } else {\n                Text(distanceText)\n                    .font(distanceFont)\n                    .lineLimit(1)\n                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)\n            }\n        }\n        .padding(padding)\n    }\n\n    private func metrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; (Font, Font, Font, Font, CGFloat, EdgeInsets) {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemSmall:\n            ",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",
